brief.en: Removes fogs and reveals invisible zombies
brief.zh: 驱散迷雾，并显示隐形的僵尸

description.en: Planterns remove fogs in a small range and reveal invisible zombies.
description.zh: 路灯花会驱散小范围内的迷雾，并使隐形的僵尸显现。

chat.en: Plantern does his job according to his past experience, "Why not do the same thing as what zombies did in the past?"
chat.zh: 路灯花根据以往的工作经验恪尽职守，“僵尸以前也喜欢隐藏他们自己，难道我们不能也这么干嘛。”

text.en: when Plant Fooded, gives each zombie 25 sun and hides nearby plants
text.zh: 施加叶绿素后，为场上所有僵尸施予 25 阳光，并使周围的植物隐身
